name: powerbi-craft
description: Power BI / Fabric report-craft skills: visuals, report UX, design language, quality gates, DAX, PBIP devops, data storytelling. Ukrainian + English.

plugins.name: pbi-visuals
plugins.description: Per-visual craft for Power BI PBIP reports: charts, tables, cards, maps, AI visuals — plus the shared report.json mechanics (powerbi-visuals).

plugins.name: pbi-report-ux
plugins.description: Page-level UX of a Power BI report: layout, navigation, slicers and filter panels, drillthrough, tooltips, mobile — plus bookmark/visibility mechanics.

plugins.name: pbi-design-language
plugins.description: How a Power BI report looks: design tokens, typography, colour accessibility, conditional formatting, theme.json, icon pipeline, ready corporate themes.

plugins.name: pbi-quality
plugins.description: Whether the report is right: chart choice strategy, evidence-gated design review, approval-gated redesign process, human-language test cases.

plugins.name: report-storytelling
plugins.description: What a report page ASSERTS: message-first headlines, comparison bases, annotation, honesty ledger — plus Ukrainian grammar of code-assembled UI strings.

plugins.name: dax-craft
plugins.description: The calculation language and code-rendered visuals: DAX measures, performance tuning, pre-measure grilling, SVG measures, Deneb/Vega-Lite specs, automated DAX regression tests.

plugins.name: pbip-devops
plugins.description: Git lifecycle of a PBIP project: scaffolding, deploy, PR review, release notes for business users, Fabric CLI operations.

plugins.name: azure-ops
plugins.description: Azure operations adjacent to BI work: cost analysis, diagnostics, RBAC, and Azure DevOps delivery rituals (work items, pull requests, hygiene inspection).

plugins.name: project-bootstrap
plugins.description: Standing up projects from zero: CLAUDE.md bootstrap for any repo, Rayfin (Fabric Apps) platform bootstrap, KPI data-entry app blueprint, React SPA UX baseline (tooltips, sticky headers, animations, optimistic saves).

plugins.name: agent-craft
plugins.description: How to run agents well: model orchestration (strong plans, cheap executes, scripts replace models), executor subagents with brief discipline, an adversarial verifier for pre-publish checks, and plain-language rules for Ukrainian user-facing reports.
